rationale: The native stationary force owner shares the standalone owner's exact FP64 VV10 key and 65536-point default crossover. Immutable geometry/grid/parameters and a bitwise comparison of every density-dependent pair ingredient protect retained force seeds. The key and predicate borrow already allocated dead scratch and the unused force scalar slot; no new device allocation, capacity receipt or fleet tier is introduced. Small grids, disabled selectors and absent/unequal keys retain complete pair sweeps. Minimum-capacity owners can also reuse seeds, without a GPU-model whitelist or approximate arithmetic.
revisit_condition: Retain complete endpoint, independent force, geometry change, failure, schedule change, minimum-capacity and actual pair-work gates when changing reuse admission or lifetime. New device rankings require real measurements; the measured Blackwell cohorts do not establish A100 performance or a universal no-regression claim.
